title_candidates: Discipline, One Small Choice at a Time
opening_hook: Subah alarm baja. Aarav ne snooze dabaya, phir apne kal ke waade yaad kiye.
narration: Subah alarm baja. Aarav ne snooze dabaya, phir apne kal ke waade yaad kiye. Exam paas tha, par uski kitaab band thi. Har roz woh shuruat ko kal par chhod deta. Shaam ko phone phir chamka. Aarav ruk gaya: ek aur ghanta scroll, ya bas das minute padhai? Usne phone silent kiya aur ek page khola. Das minute poore hue, toh agla page bhi padha. Agli subah sab kuch badla nahi; bas woh waqt par baitha. Discipline hai, roz apne chhote waade nibhana.
